name: Strike example agent #2 (conservative)
description: A second, independent Strike agent, registered the way an outsider would: from a fresh wallet through the live app's 'Run your own agent' form on Robinhood Chain testnet (v2), with its own ERC-8004 identity, a 60 USDG bond and its own TSLA cash-secured-put vault. The vault's mandate is tighter than agent #1's: |delta| 0.10-0.25, premium at least 100% of fair value, at most 50% of capacity sold, tenor 1-8 days. It proposes with the example agent's rule-based 'conservative' profile (0.15 delta at 108% of fair value, half the capacity). It never holds vault funds: the EpochManager checks every proposal against the vault's immutable mandate, and a rejected proposal slashes this agent's USDG bond to depositors.

strike.mandate: |delta| 0.10-0.25, premium >= 100% of fair value, yield >= 0.05% of collateral, size <= 50% of capacity, tenor 1-8 days
